view.title: Photo intake
view.subtitle: Photo in → suggested category → human confirmation; prompt changes are accepted on confirmed cases first
view.loadFailed: Could not load records. Use Refresh to try again.
create.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. Large photos are downsized before upload.
create.photoInvalid: This file could not be read as a photo. Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
create.failed: The case was not saved. Your photo and description are kept; try again.
common.actionFailed: Could not save. Refresh to check the latest state, then retry. Your input is kept.
setup.heading: Accept a prompt change
setup.title: Run name
setup.defaultB: Inspect visible objects and damage before selecting a category. Distinguish water-related damage from surface damage. Do not infer faults that cannot be seen. Choose unclear if evidence is insufficient.
setup.modelHint: Both versions use the workspace’s authorized default primary model, frozen on the first call. Each request contains only its prompt, category definitions and image. Use a vision-capable model.
setup.noSamples: No confirmed cases yet. Confirm a few under Intake first.
setup.calls: This comparison schedules {{count}} image-model calls, plus Assistant orchestration calls. Saving alone does not call the model.
setup.failed: Could not create the run. Check that the selected cases are confirmed and no two photos are identical, then retry.
run.configHint: Prompts and confirmed categories are frozen when the run is created. Model selection is frozen on the first call.
run.settings: Requested settings: temperature 0, maximum output 512 tokens, automatic retries 0. Provider support can vary. No shared conversation history.
run.modelPending: Default primary model; resolved on start
run.running: An image is being evaluated. Completed items are saved as the run progresses.
run.message: Run acceptance run {{id}} to completion. Process its {{count}} pending items with photo_intake_evaluate_next, one at a time, while status is ready and pending is positive. Stop on a tool-level error. Do not retry failed items or make an adoption decision.
run.sent: Request sent to the Assistant. Results refresh automatically; if the conversation stops early, use Run remaining items.
run.sendFailed: Could not send to the Assistant. In chat, ask it to continue acceptance run {{id}}.
run.empty: No acceptance runs yet. Confirm a few cases, then create one.
metrics.heading: Measured comparison
metrics.note: Latest attempts are summarized. Failures remain in the denominator; timing includes setup and failures. Small samples do not establish statistical significance. Earlier attempts remain in each sample’s history.
result.heading: Per-image comparison
result.noDifferences: No differences or mismatches in current results.
result.evidenceHint: Original output and every attempt are retained. Human review does not alter measured scores.
review.heading: Human review
decision.heading: Adoption decision
decision.hint: Record a decision and rationale after reviewing the comparison. A version with failed items cannot be adopted. Adopting A or B makes that prompt the one used for intake recognition from then on; no model is deployed or replaced.
decision.wait: Finish the remaining items before recording a decision.
result.truncated: Output exceeded the storage limit; the first 65,536 characters were retained and the item failed validation.
run.unavailable: This run is unavailable. Return to the list or refresh.
review.history: Review history (earlier notes refer to earlier attempts)
create.heading: New case
create.title: Description
create.titleHint: One line on where it is and what you saw. The description is not sent to the recognition model.
cases.heading: Cases
cases.limit: Showing the 50 most recently updated cases.
cases.empty: No cases yet. Upload a photo and add a one-line description to start.
cases.title: Description
cases.agreement: Recent confirmed cases that had a suggestion: {{agreed}} / {{total}} confirmed as suggested.
case.dialogHint: The Assistant only suggests; you confirm the category.
case.unavailable: This case is unavailable. Close this and refresh the list.
case.noPhoto: The photo for this case is missing, so it cannot be recognised. You can still confirm a category yourself.
case.analyzing: The Assistant is recognising the photo. The result updates automatically.
case.message: Recognise intake case {{id}}: call photo_intake_analyze_case once, then tell me the suggested category and the reason. Do not confirm the category for me. If the tool reports a failure, explain it and stop.
case.sent: Sent to the Assistant. The result updates automatically.
case.sendFailed: Could not send to the Assistant. In chat, ask it to recognise case {{id}}.
case.failed: Recognition failed: {{reason}}. Try again, or confirm a category yourself.
case.confirmHint: Confirming finalises this case and makes it available as a sample for prompt acceptance.
case.conflict: This case just changed and was refreshed. Check it, then confirm again.
failure.model_call_failed: Model call failed; check provider access and vision support
setup.intro: Run a candidate prompt and the current one on cases you have confirmed, then decide whether to adopt it.
run.active: {{version}} adopted in this run is now used for intake recognition.
